preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array N is between 2 and 100000 inclusive.
The number of elements that can be changed K is between 0 and the minimum of 10 and N-2 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element A[i] in the array is between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The length of the resulting array is equal to N.

postconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= result[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: Each element in the resulting array is between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for i in range(N) if result[i] != A[i]) <= K
postconditions.description: The number of elements changed in the resulting array is at most K.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] == result[0] + i * d for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: The resulting array is an arithmetic progression with the first element result[0] and common difference d.

postconditions.expression: not any((a0, d0) < (b0, d1) for a0, d0 in candidates for b0, d1 in candidates if (a0, d0) != (b0, d1))
postconditions.description: The resulting arithmetic progression is the most beautiful among all possible arithmetic progressions.
